patch_list: Install alongside original

Installs the patched app under its own package name and app name, so the original app stays installed. Push notifications and some sign-in options may not work in the separate copy. Disable it to replace the original app instead.
Sort by number of ratings
Adds Sort (off / most rated / top rated), 4★+, Hide ads and a 'Ranked' list to Meesho catalog, search and collection feeds. The ranked list orders every page the app has loaded.

sources.label: Morphe patches that declutter shopping apps. Meesho supported: no ads, product-o
sources.author: Window Shopper
patch_list: Hide bottom navigation tabs
Adds optional toggles to remove Categories, Mall and Video Finds from the bottom tab bar.
Hide loan and Pay Later profile entries
Removes the three finance entries from the account list without changing repayment or checkout.
Hide Pay Later navigation tab
Prevents Pay Later from taking the fourth navigation slot without disabling its payment services.
Hide Pay Later secondary price
Hides the Pay Later secondary price on discovery listings without changing the primary price or checkout.
Hide reel cards in feeds
Removes reel-format catalog cards from discovery feeds while leaving the video tab untouched.
Hide search recommendation trays
Removes the Gold Premium Quality and You may also like rows from search, and Similar Products rows from search, category pages and the home feed.
Hide sponsored listings and order ads
Removes active sponsored product records, two identified My Orders finance banners and the Wishlist Pay Later banner, and disables configured order ads.
Product ratings only
Removes supplier review summaries and supplier-typed catalog ratings. Missing product ratings stay missing.
Sort loaded search results by rating count
Adds a button to sort currently loaded search and category products by product rating count.
Sort search pages by rating count
Sorts each returned search page by product rating count, highest first. Does not globally reorder unloaded pages.
